name: nerdit_content_creator
description: Multi-agent NERDIT LMS course generator. Orchestrates nerdit-lesson-writer and nerdit-qa-validator subagents to turn course-[chaptername]_input.json files into a full course-[chaptername]_output.json course object (course metadata + assessment bank + per-lesson HTML, duration, and quiz questions). Includes nerdit-lesson-illustrator, which plans concept illustrations, emits prompts for user-generated images, and inserts them as small WebP files for the admin JSON + images import, and nerdit-story-video, which narrates approved illustrations into a Hinglish story video for YouTube, nerdit-video-prompts, which writes Google Veo prompts per lesson topic with exact-code overlay stills, and nerdit-presenter-shorts, which makes 9:16 shorts in the owner's own lip-synced face and voice with captions and real-code cut-ins.
